title: Master Evidence Source Registry
boundary: This registry lists priority public-record and document lanes. It is not a claim that every source has already been ingested. Each lane is a route for verification, contradiction checks and missing-record upgrades.

lanes.title: Government records
lanes.use: Primary source lane for laws, contracts, official reports, hearings, sanctions, procurement and agency records.
examples: UK Companies House and charity registers
UN / WHO / IMF / World Bank / BIS public documents

lanes.title: Court and legal records
lanes.use: Upgrade claims through complaints, judgments, indictments, settlement records, docket entries and sworn exhibits.

lanes.title: Finance and ownership records
lanes.use: Track money, voting power, mandates, holdings, proxy votes, funds, custody and beneficial ownership.

lanes.title: Contractor records
lanes.use: Track operational power through awards, vendors, services, executives, legal cases, task orders and public money.

lanes.title: Media and wire-source lane
lanes.use: Use major media for discovery, timelines and corroboration, but upgrade only with primary records where possible.

lanes.title: Document archive / WikiLeaks-style lane
lanes.use: Use document dumps as leads requiring authentication, context, cross-checks and primary-record confirmation.

lanes.title: Epstein files and related court record lane
lanes.use: Treat Epstein-related records as court/source lanes: docket documents, depositions, exhibits, official releases and named-record trails, not rumor.
examples: USVI / bank litigation records where public
flight-log and address-book claims only with source boundaries

lanes.title: Missing-record queue
lanes.use: The most important daily research tool. Every strong claim should name the next record that would prove, weaken or falsify it.
